_comment: PVT corner set consumed by sim/harness/gridspec.py (schema 1: process[], temperature_c[], supply_v{}; every other key is documentation the runner ignores).

Filled by the target spec (issue #2, spec/target-spec.md). Status follows the ratification record named in ratified_by: until that record is merged by a human the set is PROPOSED, and no result graded on it is a ratified-spec result.

process[] are section names of the pinned PDK's libs.tech/ngspice/models/cornerMOShv.lib (IHP-Open-PDK v0.3.0, sim/pdk.json): mos_tt, mos_ss, mos_ff, mos_sf, mos_fs. The hv library is the one the spec's device flavor (sg13_hv_*, DR-001 decision 2) needs; a bench names it in its base request's models.lib. The *_mismatch sections are Monte Carlo, not corners, and are selected by the harness's --mc-vary / --control-process flags.

supply_v.Vdd is the value of the voltage source named Vdd in a bench deck (klt sim alters it by name, as the smoke decks already name theirs). 2.97 / 3.30 / 3.63 V is the spec's 3.3 V +/-10 % rail (row 9). The rows are crossed with process x temperature_c: 5 x 3 x 3 = 45 corners, the full set the spec grades every pass/fail row over (DR-001 decision 7).

reduced_set is for fast iteration only and is never a recorded result (DR-001). The jitter row (row 6) runs at the same three corners, but by its own statement in spec/target-spec.md, not by reference to this key.
device_flavor: sg13_hv (3.3 V thick-oxide), models in cornerMOShv.lib

reduced_set.use: fast iteration only; never recorded as a result

narrowing: none: full MOS x +/-10 % supply x -40..125 C cross product for every pass/fail row; the jitter row's 3-corner set is stated in the spec row itself
